A food item which restores between {{Energy||12 -}} {{Energy||20}} and applies the circumspect buff when consumed. It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

Note: This recipe is only available with the ''[[Game of Crone]]'' DLC.

==Effect==

On use, a lentil cutlet will apply the circumspect buff for a duration of 2 minutes, which will give additional {{Techpoint|Blue}} when studying new items at the [[study table]]. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
